title: Prism Breaker
tagline: Twelve levels of light, one paddle between them.
description: A brick breaker with weight: the ball takes english off the paddle, bricks come in three densities, and every level you clear is remembered so you can pick the run back up where you left it.
author: HexCave
controls: Move the mouse, or arrow keys / A-D
howToPlay: Move the paddle with the mouse or the arrow keys.
Where the ball hits the paddle decides where it goes.
Clear all twelve levels — each one you reach stays unlocked.
goal: Clear all twelve levels. Every level you reach is unlocked permanently, so you can pick the run back up later.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
